article.headline: Milwaukee hosts Oklahoma City on home slide
article.description: Oklahoma City Thunder (10-9, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. Milwaukee Bucks (2-18, 15th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Milwaukee hosts Oklahoma City on home slide
article.linkText: Milwaukee hosts Oklahoma City on home slide
article.story: Oklahoma City Thunder (10-9, ninth in the Western Conference) vs. Milwaukee Bucks (2-18, 15th in the Eastern Conference) Milwaukee; Saturday, 8 p.m. EST LINE: Thunder -11.5; over/under is 228.5 BOTTOM LINE: Milwaukee looks to end its eight-game home losing streak with a win against Oklahoma City. The Bucks are 1-9 on their home court. Milwaukee is ninth in the Eastern Conference with 13.6 fast break points per game led by Jaime Jaquez Jr. averaging 2.7. The Thunder have gone 4-7 away from home. Oklahoma City scores 113.0 points while outscoring opponents by 2.6 points per game. The Bucks' 14.7 made 3-pointers per game this season are just 0.6 fewer made shots on average than the 15.3 per game the Thunder allow. The Thunder are shooting 46.3% from the field, which equals what the Bucks' opponents have shot this season. TOP PERFORMERS: Jaquez is shooting 46.7% and averaging 14.5 points for the Bucks. Tyler Herro is averaging 20.7 points over the last 10 games. Ajay Mitchell is shooting 47.9% and averaging 17.2 points for the Thunder. Jared McCain is averaging 2.7 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Bucks: 1-9, averaging 108.6 points, 43.5 rebounds, 23.3 assists, 8.5 steals and 5.1 blocks per game while shooting 43.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 118.1 points per game. Thunder: 3-7, averaging 113.9 points, 44.2 rebounds, 24.1 assists, 7.9 steals and 4.8 blocks per game while shooting 47.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 113.0 points. INJURIES: Bucks: Kasparas Jakucionis: out (ankle). Thunder: Cason Wallace: out (shoulder), Thomas Sorber: out (knee), Chet Holmgren: out (knee), Jalen Williams: out (ankle), Aday Mara: day to day (shin), Jaylin Williams: day to day (back), Nikola Topic: day to day (hip). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
